## Normalization (only the certified two)

1. **15 Phase-11-only tags removed from the semantic lane** (`metadata.tags.primary/supporting/all` and `metadata.tagProvenance`; emptied provenance lanes dropped). No remapping, no ontology change. Typed abilities, exact skills/feats/talents/form refs and class routes were not touched.
   Removals by tag: `ability_cha` 199, `ability_con` 97, `ability_dex` 164, `ability_int` 215, `ability_str` 51, `ability_wis` 282, `accuracy` 15, `advanced_melee` 19, `area_damage` 1, `fieldcraft` 278, `finesse` 13, `hacking` 1, `lightsaber_form` 13, `rifle` 20, `starship` 24 — these match the audit's per-tag record counts exactly.
2. **12 form-power ids corrected** to `ForceRegistry` identities (e.g. `lightsaber-form-power-vornskr-s-ferocity` → `vornskrs-ferocity`); 64 replacements across `mechanics` and `metadata.exactRefs`.

| Semantic lane | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Unique tags | 57 | **42** (all in the frozen 190-tag ontology) |
| Avg primary / supporting per archetype | 6.31 / 6.39 | **3.86 / 4.15** |
| Archetypes with ≥1 canonical primary tag | 297 | **297** (0 emptied) |

`_meta` keeps the production metadata and adds `phase12a` (source fingerprint, normalization record, post-normalization tag vocabulary). `phase11Validation.tagVocabulary/canonicalTagsUsed` are marked superseded there.

## Registry: new API and compatibility behavior

New SSOT lane (class is a route, never identity; no weights or biases): `getArchetype(id)`, `getAllArchetypes()`, `getParents()`, `getSpecializations()`, `getParent(id)`, `getChildren(parentId)`, `getByClassRoute(classId, tier?)`, `getExactRefs(id)`, `resolveExactRefs(id, adapters?)`, `getCompatibilityView(id)`, `isSSOTLoaded()`, `getSSOTMeta()`; `getStats()` gains an additive `ssot` field. Records are deep-frozen and returned in dataset order.

- **Legacy lane untouched.** `get/getByClass/getAll/getStats().count/classes/getPrestigeSignals` still read `class-archetypes.json` + world items. A test proves the legacy snapshot is byte-identical with and without the SSOT lane, and that SSOT ids never appear in `getAll()`.
- **Fail-closed isolation.** `_loadSSOT()` validates the payload; unreachable (404/network) or invalid data disables only the SSOT lane and logs. Legacy initialization is unaffected.
- **`getCompatibilityView`** exposes typed/exact data only (class route, ability order, exact skill keys) with **empty** `mechanicalBias/roleBias/attributeBias/tagBias`. It cannot become a second semantic authority.
- **`resolveExactRefs`** reuses `ForceRegistry`, `SpeciesRegistry`, `ClassesRegistry`, `FeatRegistry` (exact normalized-name identity) and `BackgroundRegistry` via lazily imported adapters (no import-time coupling). Skills, talent trees and talents report `checked: false` at runtime — the live registries do not carry canonical identity keys — and are verified offline by the builder against the Phase 3 manifests. An unchecked domain is never reported as resolved.

## Known defects

- **Jedi class-skill authority (fixed, narrow).** `progression-data.js` listed Climb, Persuasion, **Stealth** and Swim and omitted Mechanics; canonical Jedi (`packs/classes.db`) is Acrobatics, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Knowledge (all), Mechanics, Perception, Pilot, Use the Force. Corrected in place (Knowledge expanded to the seven fields). The only reader of this hard-coded table found in the repo is the Force-sensitivity fallback in `progression-actor-updater.js`, which uses a different field, so behavior impact is nil today; the fix protects Phase 12B+ route-cost work. Regression tests compare against `packs/classes.db`.
- **Same drift remains in the other four base classes** (Soldier, Noble, Scout, Scoundrel; differences listed in `tests/progression-data-jedi-class-skills.test.mjs`). Left unchanged — out of Phase 12A scope — and pinned by a test so it can't change unnoticed. Preferred end state: progression consumers read normalized class data instead of the hand-authored table.
- **`fieldcraft` in `metadata.routes`.** `routes.all` is a separate class-route lane (not the semantic lane) and still contains the string `fieldcraft`; left as authored. Decide in 12B whether route labels need their own vocabulary.
- `data/metadata-assignments.json` exists in the repo (older audit said absent on main); no consumer of it was examined here.
